notes.title: Vaccine Rebirth releases on May 25th
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=RnLQ2eMKviU;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to step into a nightmare realm like no other as Vaccine Rebirth will release on May 25th.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels with each playthrough, ensuring a unique and unpredictable experience every time.

Encounter a multitude of nightmarish creatures and uncover hidden secrets as you fight for your life against overwhelming odds. 

Team up with a friend in local couch co-op mode, forging an alliance against the malevolent forces that haunt the forsaken premises.

Will you have what it takes to survive the relentless horrors that await?

Vaccine Rebirth will release for 6.99$, but a 25% discount will be available for owners of the original Vaccine.

notes.title: Vaccine Rebirth!
notes.notes:
Last year I started working on Vaccine 2 and after having some of the new features implemented, I thought it would be interesting to have those in a re-envisioned version of the original Vaccine.
Vaccine Rebirth expands on the original version with new monsters, rooms, weapons, gameplay or a local co-op mode!

You can have a look and wishlist Vaccine Rebirth store here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252790/Vaccine_Rebirth/

Vaccine Rebirth will be released by the end of Q1/Beginning of Q2 with a price tag of 6.99$ but the game will be bundled with the original version with a 25% discount, so owners of the original game can get an automatic discount if they decide to try it out! 

Also, if you are interested to know the main differences between the versions, here are some of the changes:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2252790/discussions/0/3770110414844542160/

Enter once again into the world of Survival Horror!
